title_en: GTA Online: A Safehouse in the Hills Coming December 10 - Rockstar Games
excerpt_en: Prime luxury real estate comes to GTA Online in A Safehouse in the Hills, the monumental new update arriving December 10 on PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, and PC.
